metadata.description: Jonathan Dick's collection of portable, cross-agent skills for Claude Code, Copilot CLI, and friends.

plugins.name: skill-reflect
plugins.description: Session-based reflection on distributed skill performance, with explicit local-skill review support. Defaults to scrubbed findings in chat, writes a local report only when requested, and requires destination-specific authorization before filing any GitHub issue. Ships opt-in hooks that stage tiny local candidate markers (no AI, no network) and a maintainer skill for vendoring and drift checks.

plugins.name: app-stores
plugins.description: Take an app's store listing from one config to the App Store and Google Play: words per locale, store rules as dated and sourced data checked offline, fastlane-compatible output, a preview of each store's page, and a look-first send (plan, then apply exactly that plan); plus screenshots designed per store from real captures, every size and locale from one design, with drawn device frames and checks; and the captures themselves, taken at exactly each store's sizes on any stack (a screenshot mode, the DevFlow or Ailoha in-app agents, Appium, XCUITest, UI Automator, Maestro, simctl, adb, headless Chrome, or imported), with preview videos encoded to spec; and the App Store previews themselves, composed from real recordings with headlines, touch hotspots, a spotlight, drawn device frames and an end card. Any app, any stack. Stdlib Python; network only when sending, only to the stores' own APIs; capture talks only to this machine.

plugins.name: maui-desktop
plugins.description: Build a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux with .NET MAUI: native controls where the look and feel matters most (window, sidebar, toolbar, menus, dialog frames, tray), Blazor Hybrid content everywhere else, and no seams between them. Reads an existing project first, interviews the user in one message with a proposed answer for every question (platforms, native or web per surface, dialogs, per-platform look, tray, notifications, deep links, updates, distribution), records the decisions with reasons and a gap report; then a design language both sides read: DESIGN.md, one tokens file generating the CSS and the C# native chrome uses, one icons file mapped to SF Symbols, Adwaita, Segoe Fluent and an SVG sprite, per-platform differences, a seam checklist, and contrast and lint gates that ratchet an existing app onto tokens. The skills teach structure; they never paste template code into the app. Stdlib Python on macOS, Linux and Windows; no network.
